{{Quote|Authorization was granted by Sector Three Command and Control. If you have any complaints, take them up with the regional governor.|A [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]]|<ref name="DL:TRoDV" />}}
'''Sector 3''' was the theaters of operations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Third Mid Rim Army|3rd Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was reorganized in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oversector/Legends|Priority Sector]] and placed under the rule of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="EGTW5">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22128732052/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-5|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 5}}</ref>

It was reorganized by the time of the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and extended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] as far as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] and was controlled by a regional governor based on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] in [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]].<ref name="DL:TRoDV" />
